records.name: Southeastern Pennsylvania Group, Sierra Club
records.summary: The Philadelphia area volunteer group of the Sierra Club, covering the city and nearby counties. It leads outdoor trips and conservation work in the region.
records.what_you_do: Join an outing led by a volunteer leader, or fill in the group's volunteer interest form to be connected with a leader.

first_step.how: Fill in the Volunteer Interest Form on the group's site to be connected with an outing leader.
first_step.basis: The group's live outings calendar would not load, so it is not clear how a newcomer joins an outing.

records.notes: The group home page and the outings page both loaded empty on repeated fetches. This record rests on search result summaries of those pages, so treat it as unconfirmed. The search results list a Meetup group and a Facebook page for outings; these are leads only and were not read. The newest dated item seen was a blog post whose web address is dated 2023 July, which is not current evidence. No current outing dates were confirmed.

records.name: Strawberry Mansion Community Development Corporation
records.summary: A Strawberry Mansion neighborhood nonprofit that works on housing repair, historic preservation, and resident programs. It hosts free family events, such as a spring movie night at The Yard.
records.what_you_do: Come to free community events, sign up for the newsletter, or use the volunteer page to ask how to help with the group's housing and land care programs.

schedule.text: Free family events such as a movie night on Friday, May 15, 2026, 7 to 10 pm. No recurring schedule is published.

first_step.how: Watch the group's site for the next free community event and come along, or email info@strawberrymansioncdc.org to ask how to volunteer.
first_step.basis: Free family events are open to the public, and the site lists a volunteer page and an email address for questions.

records.notes: The group's home page lists no office address, so none is recorded. The Love Your Park page lists the movie night as 7:30 to 10 PM; the group's own event page says 7 to 10 PM, so the event page is used. The event page names the organizers as this group and the Fairmount Park Conservancy. The home page's newest item is a community potluck listed as Sunday, October 18 with no year shown; it is not used as evidence. Movie night registration showed as closed.

records.name: Two Street Stompers
records.summary: A comic division Mummers club that marches in the New Year's Day parade. The 2026 official lineup lists it under the Goodtimers NYA mother club.
records.what_you_do: Members march in the New Year's Day parade as part of the comic division. The lineup page does not say what else the club does.

schedule.text: Marches in the New Year's Day parade, which begins at 9 am at City Hall

first_step.how: Ask the parade office through its contact form how to reach the club, since the lineup page lists no club contact.
first_step.basis: No club contact or join process is published, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: No website for the club itself was found. The parade site is the only source. The lineup page does not print a date; it names the 2026 parade, which is the New Year's Day 2026 march, so the sign of life is January 2026. The parade contact page has a form and no club or membership contact. No clubhouse address is on the page, so no location is recorded.

records.name: Washington Square West Civic Association
records.summary: The neighborhood civic association for Washington Square West. It co-hosts Love Your Park garden days with Farm Philly, including the May 2026 Open Garden Day at Sartain and Waverly Gardens and at South Street Garden.
records.what_you_do: Come help at the Love Your Park open garden days, or meet the association's volunteers there. The park page does not describe the association's regular meetings.

schedule.text: Open Garden Day on Saturday, May 9, 2026: 9 AM to 12 PM at Sartain and Waverly Gardens, and 10 AM to 2 PM at South Street Garden

first_step.how: Come to a Love Your Park open garden day, such as the May 9 event, and ask the volunteers on site how to join the association.
first_step.basis: Garden days are public, but the page gives no sign-up step and the association's own website could not be reached.

records.notes: The association's own website (www.wswca.org) did not resolve, and the searches found no other official site, so no contact details are recorded. Newest evidence is the 2026 Love Your Park page. Older 2024 news about a board vote and a historic district is not used for status. The page links to a shared document for the garden day with no sign-up details; it was not opened.

records.name: Women in GIS, Delaware Valley chapter

records.what_you_do: Meet other women who work in GIS through the chapter's networking. The chapter listing shows no meeting dates.

first_step.how: Use the chapter contact link on the Local Chapters page at womeningis.org to ask about the next networking event.
first_step.basis: No meeting dates or sign-up steps are published; the way in is a contact link to the chapter leads.

records.notes: The chapter has no page of its own. Its listing on the national chapters page is a working page with no dates, which is why status is probably_active. The chapter contact is an email address on that page and is not copied here. The page says creating new chapters is paused. The Meetup group under the same name is a lead only and was not read.

notes: Used all 3 WebSearch calls and 15 fetches. Verdicts: 7 publish, 0 hide, 0 not_a_group, 0 duplicate, 0 out_of_area.
